{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and exclude internal test orders
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")

# Filter out test orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[~df['revenue'].isin(['999,999.99']) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders)
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
